name: com.rtmpe.sdk
description: Real-Time Multiplayer Engine — Unity client SDK for converting single-player games to multiplayer in under 15 minutes.

samples.description: Demonstrates connecting to the RTMPE server, handling connection events, and graceful disconnect.
Connect, open a room and spawn the local player, with the prefab id resolved from the generated registry rather than typed into a field.
A room moving between two scenes with no scene-loading code: RtmpeSceneLoader does the loading and the reporting, the sample decides only when.

Two clients in one room, moving. Matchmaking opens the room, a shipped component supplies the API key a build cannot get from the Editor, and the avatar requires both motion components rather than trusting a prefab to carry them.
